notes.text: After work grew, Self (pottery) is 8h. Growing work never touches it, and nothing stops Clients landing on her Friday pottery day.
No way to lock a day or an hours block as protected. Self time is protected only by her own discipline.
Hours audit: Clients 40h = 24 placed + 16 left, Home 4h = 0 placed + 4 left, Self (pottery) 8h = 6 placed + 2 left, Admin 8h = 8 placed + 0 left
The app never showed an overbooking or over-capacity message.
